review: Expected answers and exact source proofs were written by an AI solver from the collected source text. They are not reviewed by a lawyer and must not be read as legal advice.
scope: Bounded set over the five-record demo corpus. Passing cases show retrieval of an exact proof span, not legal correctness of an answer, and not coverage outside these records.
